shared_elements: schematic animal or creature with reduced, simplified anatomy
raptor-like head with pronounced brow ridge over eyes
limbs/wings held close against the body
justification: Both surfaces depict a bird-like creature with a heavy curved beak and simplified, boldly schematic anatomy, and in each the limbs/wings are folded tight against the body rather than spread. But A is a multi-register composition combining rows of quadrupeds, a zigzag band, profile canids, small human-like and bird-headed figures and a plant motif, whereas B is a single frontal head-and-shoulders creature with no accompanying figures, ornament or registers, so relationships and arrangement scarcely correspond.
